owner.name: Dev Okafor
owner.bio: Dev Okafor ran exterior maintenance crews for property management companies across the Treasure Valley — swapping air filters, patching drywall, and scrubbing enough grimy siding to last two lifetimes. Eventually Dev bought a second pressure washer, printed some door hangers, and started knocking on doors personally. Grit & Gleam is still a two-person outfit: Dev drives most jobs, texts you back personally, and walks every finished job with you before packing up the hose.

pricing.label: Driveway Refresh
pricing.note: Extra square footage past 600 ft² is billed at $0.18/ft² — quoted before we start, never after.

pricing.label: Full Exterior Wash
pricing.note: Two-story homes or heavy staining get a confirmed adjusted price before booking — never a surprise on the invoice.

pricing.label: Deck & Fence Restore
pricing.per: flat, up to 400 sq ft of deck
pricing.note: Bigger deck or a full privacy fence? Text a photo and we'll quote the real number in minutes.

surfaces.name: Driveways & Walkways
surfaces.blurb: Hot-water blast lifts oil stains, tire marks and years of ground-in grime that concrete cleaners can't touch.

surfaces.name: House Siding
surfaces.blurb: Low-pressure soft-wash on vinyl, stucco and painted surfaces — strong enough for algae and pollen, gentle enough not to strip a finish.

surfaces.name: Roof Soft-Washing
surfaces.blurb: Kills the black streaks (that's algae, not dirt) without a single pound of pressure ever touching a shingle.

surfaces.name: Decks & Fences
surfaces.blurb: Wood brightening pulls out gray weathering and mildew, leaving bare wood ready for stain or sealant.

surfaces.name: Commercial & HOA
surfaces.blurb: Sidewalks, dumpster pads, storefronts and shared amenities — scheduled on a route so nothing gets forgotten.
